watchlist.notes: BEARISH PLAY. Buy when QQQ MA20 < MA50 AND tech sector has STRONG_SELL signal. Size at 2.5-5%. Not for long-term holding — decay factor. Exit when QQQ recovers MA20.

watchlist.notes: BEARISH PLAY. Buy when SPY MA20 < MA50 AND macro regime is risk-off (VIX > 20). Exit quickly — leveraged ETF decay. Max hold 5 days.
